balls.text: Yadav slogs, Mishra misfields at short fine leg, and concedes three extras
slugged away to long-on. Yadav tries to come back for the second, but there isn't enough time for that
nice shot. This is a half-volley, possibly a yorker gone wrong, he goes deep into the crease and lofts this straight back over Perera's head
nearly a yorker, outside off, dug out, but he gets in a dot
full, outside off, driven to long-on
driven to long-on for one
backs away to cut a short ball to third man for one
quick, short of a length, on off, bunted into the off side for one
short of a length, too far down the leg side, called wide
short of a length, on off, defended off the front foot
full and straight, defended back to him

Steyn, you beauty. Too good an outswinger for a tailender. It's actually bowled cross-seam, but behaves like a perfect outswinger. Pitches middle and off, Nadeem has his outside edge beaten, and the off stump flattened. Another golden duck
slower ball, on the pads, worked away to fine leg for one
full, on off, driven to long-off
short, wide, upper-cut away, finds third man. Another golden duck for Delhi who have been finding fielders to perfection
full outside off, steered to third man for one
Pathan has picked out deep midwicket. This was in the slot, on a length and on the pads. Pathan plays the pick-up shot, but doesn't get enough on in, and has found out the fielder in the deep
length ball outside off, driven to long-on
slower ball, a proper offbreak, turning from outside leg, gets a leading edge towards mid-off
short of a length, outside off, punched to point. Finally, the over ends
wide full toss, and this one is a big wide, and called again
full and wide, out of Pathan's reach, and is called wide. Slightly harsh for mine
walks down at him, Sharma digs this in short, cut away to deep point for one
another slower ball, shortish, outside off, punched away for a single
short of a length, on off, steered away to third man
slower short ball, Jadhav looks to run it down to third man, but is beaten by the slowness this time
Sharma bowls a slower ball right in the slot. Jadhav has picked it early and launched it back over his head. Eleven off one legal delivery this over
is this the freeing the shackles? Sharma not only oversteps, but is also cut away for four. To the right of third man. Takes from in front of the stumps by backing away
full toss, outside off, misses out as he has hit it straight to point
short of a length, widish, dabbed away to third man
full, middle and leg, driven to long-on
steered away to third man
full, on off, driven to long-off
short of a length, on off, pushed back to him
length ball outside off, swiped away to long-on for one
short, into the body, pulled away to deep square
short of a length, on off, defended to point
tucked away off the hip for a single
short of a length, wide, cut away to sweeper-cover
short of a length, on off, pushed to cover for one
short of a length, just outside off, cut away to sweeper-cover
flighted on off, slower through the air, defended back to him
short of a length, on off, punched down to long-on
goes for the big drive outside off, not quite to its pitch, and gets a thick edge to point. One for goes. Surely he would have scored more with an "ad" in his name instead of "un"
tossed up on off, Juneja tries the big sweep and is beaten
short, not too wide, cut away to deep cover
short, too short, pulled away in the air, and wide of midwicket. Gets a couple
short of a length, down the leg side, gets a single to fine leg
short of a length, no room, middle and off, defended back to him
wide down the leg side
steered away to third man for one
short of a length, into the ribs, worked to fine leg
short of a length, outside off, beats the push, bounces in front of the keeper
length ball, turning in towards leg, pushed to deep midwicket for a single
full, middle and leg, worked wide of deep square leg for a couple
flighted on off, driven to sweeper-cover for one
short of a length, a bit too short, pulled away to deep midwicket
flighted on off, again wristed to leg for a single
short of a length, on the stumps, worked to leg off the back foot
dug in short, into the ribs, fended to leg for a single
bouncer, Pathan goes for the pull despite being forward, and gets a top edge, which flies over the keeper's head
dug in short this time, angling in towards the chest, fended off the back foot
full and fast, and angling in, defended back to him
short of a length, outside off, pushed to point
length ball, just outside off, pushed to cover
short of a length, on off, punched to point
plays across the line, Mishra beats him with the legbreak, but it is clearly pitched on off, and is missing the stumps
tossed up, on off, defended off the back foot
driven to long-off for a single this time
flighted on off, pushed back to him
flat, middle and leg, defended to leg, takes a single
throws away his wicket. Just before the timeout. Short, widish, but doesn't quite come on. A bit of tennis-ball bounce. Botha fails to keep the cut down, and finds point to perfection
wide length ball, nicely played. He moves forward into the drive, opens the face late, and it races off the bat to beat third man
gets across to play this. The bounce cramps him up, but he manages to mis-time it wide of long leg, and has time to come back for the second
short of a length, outside off, dabbed away to third man for one
nicely driven, but straight to short extra cover
driven, in front of his body, but hit powerfully enough to elude the outstretched hand of the bowler, and they charge back for the second
nicely flighted, on off, turning away slightly, pushed to cover. Four overs without a boundary now
worked to leg from wide outside off for a single
slower, fuller, 86ks, punched away to sweeper-cover
flatter, just outside off, defended
tossed up wide, teasing him, Juneja goes hard at it, gets an edge into Patel's pad
length ball, turning away slightly. He looks to cut, but is cramped
short, wide, gets away with it as this is cut straight to point
short of a length, widish, holds its line there and beats his drive
short, doesn't get up, runs this down to third man
nicely played. All Indian wrists in there. Takes this length ball from outside off and whips it between mid0on and midwicket. On the walk too
wrsitily flick from just outside off, straight to mid-on
on a length, just outside off, defended off the front foot
defended back to him
left alone. And this is straight too, but headed down leg. Only slightly but still
short of a length, just outside off, punched to point
half-volley outside off, driven nicely but straight to mid-off
short of a length, middle and leg, he gets inside the line to work it to leg
widish length ball, left alone. This one bounces in front of the keeper
wide length ball, he pushes at it, gets an edge, a soft one, and it falls in front and to the left of second slip
length ball, just outside off, defended to point
Sharma on a hat-trick. Delhi people are going after Delhi people everywhere. Sehwag punches at a wide one, gets a thick edge, White is placed superbly at a wide slip, and he takes a tumbling one

Sharma gets Jayawardene. A shot perhaps borne out of pressure of slow scoring? Just short of a length this is, and Jayawardene has made up his mind this has to go. However, it is not full enough for the straight loft, and he gets too under it, and skies it to mid-on. They check for the no-ball, but Ishant is good. Not by much, but he is
dug in short, he rides the bounce, bunts this into the leg side, and races away for a single
short of a length, just outside off, Sehwag punches at thin air as he is beaten by the bounce

not lucky this time. Slower ball, full and wide, and Jayawardene has driven this through the packed of-side field. To the right of cover. An over that deserved to go for much more than the nine it eventually did
short and wide again, and Perera gets away again. This has been only lucky over. Cut straight to point
short, wide, moving away slightly, beats Jayawardene on the cut
throws his bat at a wide length ball, gets a thick edge to third man for one
short, not too wide, Sehwag goes for the cut, but is beaten by the lack of room
and is despatched first ball. Short, wide, gentle pace, and Sehwag leans back to cut it powerfully to the left of point and to the right of third man
dug in short, at 141ks, doesn't quite come on to the bat, though, and Sehwag has to delay his attempt to ramp him, and ends up playing towards square third man for one
short of a length, outside off, steered to third man for one
short of a length, on off, no room, defended off the back foot
short of a length, angling in, beats the flick, but another leg-bye ensues
another non-swinger, and this time he gets a leg-bye
this one doesn't swing. Mahela is beaten on the inside edge, but this is headed down leg, and so the appeal is denied
short of a length, wide, Sehwag flays at it, gets a thick edge, wide of slip
short of a length, outside off, dabbed towards point, and Sehwag calls him through for one
length ball, on the pads, Mahela plays a nice little pick-up shot over square leg. Gets a lot of height on this, but enough distance to clear the field
length ball, on off, moving in a bit, defended back to him
short of a length, just outside off, defended off the back foot
risky run to get off the mark. Pushed hard to mid-off, and charges off. No direct hit, though
superb bowling. Wicket-maiden. Another outswinger, the edge is soft this time, but White does really well to dive to his right at second slip and field this

superb delivery. That's a Test-match delivery, but not quite Test-much keeping from Parthiv Patel. Perhaps he is not used to this kind of swing. Steyn bowls a perfect outswinger, Jaywardene pushes at the length, gets a solid edge to Parthiv's right, but he seems to have followed the angle and his weight is towards leg before he changes direction and dives wide of off. He gets a hand to this but the catch doesn't stick

Warner keeps the proud Delhi-Duck tradition going. Has taken from not right where Chand left, but he has scored a duck nonetheless. Looks to drive hard at this one, the ball swings and hits the inside half of the bat and lobs to mid-on
this one dies on its way to the keeper. Bowled a little shorter than the previous two, and Warner is caught on the crease, and is beaten on the inside edge
full and swingng in again, driven nicely again, but Sanga makes a nice diving save at short extra
full, swinging in towards off at 144ks, driven nicely to mid-off

slower ball, but try telling those who have only seen this rocket away for four. Fiercely, savagely hit to finally win this match. Short of a lenght, slow, Steyn sets up and smashes it straight for four
length ball, outside off, Steyn drives, clears point with the slice, gets two, crucial two
done in by pace. Short, outside off, Mishra looks for the late-cut, but is late into it. Yadav does redeem himself after that four first ball
Mishra tries the ramp, but is beaten. This could have been over. Not a smart ball. Too short, and only chest high
slower ball, gets a leading edge from Steyn, concedes a single to third man
bowled from behind the stumps. On a length, outside off, driven to short cover
length ball, on off, Mishra looks to work to leg, gets a leading edge, past short cover, for one
no redemption song for Yadav tonight? Short, not too wide, but he arches back superbly and he upper-cuts it over point. Mishra is making up for that misfield at the end of the first innings?

superb shot, superb fielding. Short of a length, outside off, absolutely smoked away to the right of deep cover, but Nadeem puts in the dive, gets a hand to it, and then gets a hand to the ricochet even as he is sliding. That's two runs saved
tries the ramp, but this is a slower ball so it doesn't beat short fine leg

lovely catch by Botha. Delhi refuse to die, Hyderabad refuse to step over the line. Did anyone say tie? Wide length ball, slower I presume, Perera lofts down the ground but doesn't time it well. Botha sets himself up at the edge of the boundary, and takes it overhead. Makes it look easy, but believe me this is a difficult catch. He has judged this early and perfectly, he knows where he is with respect to the boundary, and then he has executed it perfectly
pushes at a wide length ball, it goes off the thick outside edge for a single
slower offcutter, short of a length, Mishra is beaten on the punch

they are appealing for obstructing the field. Mishra tries the ramp, is hit on the back of his bat, to cover. Perera wants the single, Mishra responds, and the throw hits his back. Now we don't know if Mishra changed his line. Mishra is fine. He never looked at the fielder, and never changed direction. And Sunrisers are so desperate they take the overthrow off the body. Mahela Jayawardene is letting his displeasure known. Just to rub it in, Mishra is hit on the back when taking the second too
Jadhav gets a touch to this one. Full and just outside off, the edge flies, but the diving Jadhav gets a touch to take the sting off it and saves three runs
that's no tailender shot. Fullish, on the pads, and he has flicked this away just wide of long leg for two
Mishra has smoked this one. Slower one, but on a length, on middle and leg, in the natural swing of a tailender, and he has sent this flying over midwicket
full and wide, Mishra tries to drive, is beaten by the pace
yorker, but he has overstepped. Is this the turning point? Perfect yorker, but he has to now bowl a free hit
slower ball again, gets extra bounce, hits the higher part of the bat
looks like the slower ball, and Morkel has shifted the balance again. Reddy backs away again, Morkel bowls the fast offcutter, Reddy is early into his swipe, and the leg stump is flat
moves back and across to this skiddy short ball. Is late into it, but the mistimed pull falls safe in the leg side
Reddy is backing away to everything, but it is working. This time he gets a thick edge that flies over the keeper and the slip. Now the asking rate is close to a run a ball
backs away to hit this slower ball between mid-off and cover. Not the prettiest of the shots, but I don;t know a team that will turn down these four runs
short, quick, clearly late into the pull, gets a single off the bottom edge
backs away to hit at a quick length ball, the outside edge avoids slip and goes for a single
pushed wide of sweeper-cover for two
more pace and bounce, guided away past point for one. Morkel tumbles in his follow-through, Warner dives at point but doesn't get a touch. Bodies on the ground
pace like fiyah, but they take two. This is a brute rising towards the chest from a length, but it goes sofly off the glove and into the vacant space on the leg side
worked away off the pads for a single. Reddy wants the second, but is rightly sent back
driven on the up, wide of point, gets a single
Vihari is gone. Drives at a length ball, but Morkel's extra bounce hits him high on the bat, and mid-off takes a sharp catch. Good on Mahela for having that mid-off up too
short of a length, driven to point, takes a risky single, Warner goes for the run-out, and concedes an overthrow. Backing up is not good

that's a brain freeze. White has charged down at Nadeem, and hoicked across the line of a shortish delivery. He charged too soon perhaps, Nadeem shortened the length, and White has virtually run past one
on a length, on off, defended off the front foot
down the track again, drives this to long-off for one
placed between cover-point and cover for one
down the wicket, right to its pitch, drills it back at Nadeem, who misfields to allow them the single
slightly short, punched to deep cover for one
driven nicely, but straight to mid-on. Another good over for Delhi. Just two off
full, into the pads, flicked away to deep square leg
on a length, on off, defended to short cover
short of a length, outside off, dabs on it, gets a single wide of slip
short of a length, looks to run this down to third man. Beaten clearly by the pace. And there is a slip in place for good measure. Not a smart shot
on a length, on off, pushed to short cover
down the wicket to drive this to long-on for one
defended back to him
Clears Sid Kaul by inches. Driven inside-out, towards long-off. Kaul is not all the way back, he has had to back-track, and it goes through his fingers for a six
driven nicely to deep cover for one

ho ho ho. That ball has lodged so deep into the helmet grille it might get out of shape when pulled out. Looks to paddle this, gets a top edge into the helmet, and the ball decides to take a nap there. Patel tries, Sehwag tries, and finally Warner is able to pull it out. Warner manages a mock appeal too
short of a length, Vihari gets an inside edge for one

Sehwag is sharp enough at slip without spectacles. This is game on. Absolutely on. Sanga looks to back-cut again. The ball is not short enough, and Sehwag coolly accepts the thick edge at slip. In front of his left knee
slightly shorter, late-cut away, but can't beat point
slower through the air, flighted higher too. Sanga tries to loft this down the ground, but is beaten on the inside. No turn on this one
down the wicket again, gets the single to long-on
slightly short, punched away to point, where a misfield from Yadav allows them the single
down the wicket to drive this to long-on for one
slower in the air, guided to short third man for one
arm ball, angling in towards off, defended off the back foot
slower through the air, short of a length, pushed to backward point
short of a length, cut away, can;t beat point
down the wicket, beaten in the flight, is hit on the front pad onto the back and rolls towards the wicketkeeper. Sanga makes it back just in time
another leading edge, but this is soft and dies as soon as it leaves the bat
flighted on the pads, flicked to short midwicket
driven to long-off for one
topspinner, Vihari goes back to work this to leg
tossed up on off, defended to leg
slightly shorter, he goes back to work this to deep square for one
sharp offbreak. On a length, on off, he plays the angle, and is beaten by the turn
tossed up on off, defended to cover
short ball, outside off, cut straight to point
leading edge back to Nadeem. This is slow in the air again, Patel tries to flick it to leg, is early into it, gets a healthy leading edge, and Nadeem goes back to the stumps and accepts the dolly
slower through the air, worked to short fine again
turning into the pads, concedes the single to short fine
short of a length, on the pads, worked to short fine for a single
goes right back to cut this off the stumps, but can't beat point
stays back to defend a fullish delivery
down the wicket to drive this to long-off for one
defended back to him
lovely chip. Sanga is down the wicket, plays a pick-up off the toes. Morkel at deep midwicket makes a dive to go for the catch but can't reach it
flighted, on off, pushed back to him
what a flick. Length ball, middle and leg, and he has placed it between mid-on and midwicket. Hyderabad are well and truly on their way now

cut in the air this time. Patel follows Sanga's lead, but this is an easier shot to ply because he is using Yadav's pace as opposed to going against it. This is short, not too wide, but he goes deliberately over point with the cut
full outside off, driven with an open face, finds point with it
short of a length, outside off, tries to punch it away, gets a thick edge to third man
defended off the back foot this time
amazing shot. Wide length ball, he goes down on a knee, and drives it in the air, and over cover. To do that against somebody bowling in mid-140s is incredible
length ball, outside off, sliced away to point
wristily played. Slightly too straight, and he has glanced this fine for four
tucked away off the pads, to the right of Yadav at deep square. Yadav tries to lob this to the other man charging in from the infield, but lobs it wide, and they take one more than they should have
nicely done. Drops this shortish delivery at his feet and takes a single
another superb-looking square-drive from Sanga. Boy is he looking ominous today? However, this one has been stopped by a diving Botha at cover-point
short of a length, on the pads, bunted to leg for one
nice-looking square drive on the up, but finds cover-point with it
that's muscled down the ground. Full, outside off, and he swipes it between the bowler and mid-on. That has rocketed away
back to normal pace, driven to point
slower ball, short of a length, angling away, punched between cover and cover-point for four. Kaul's honeymoon is over
I don't see Sid Kaul going for a run. Ever. On a length, outside off, pushed to short cover
Kaul is not yet scored off. Digs this one in short, gets good bounce towards the chest, cut away to cover-point
fullish, swinging, Patel wants to cut, and is beaten
short of a length, just outside off, punched to cover-point
pulled away again. Once again, not too short, but he has got enough bat on this to clear square leg and go for four
short-arm pull to midwicket. Not short enough, but he does well
short of a length, angling in, pushed to mid-on softly for a single
short of a length, on off, defended back to him
Kaul begins his IPl career with a maiden. Full, on off, pushed to cover. Surely this is a first? His first IPL over, and it's a maiden
length ball, on off, pushed to cover
length ball, on off, left alone to angle away
on a length, on off, pushed to mid-off

that's superb fielding. He is gone for all money here. Nadeem has stunned Reddy. Pushed to leg for what looks like a regulation single, but Nadeem swoops in from midwicket, and throws it one motion, and direct onto the stumps at the non-striker's end. Gone by one frame. Closer than what it looked to me, but I would have given this out without the third umpire
full, on off, driven to mid-on
short of a length, outside off, dabbed away to third man for one
this one doesn't swing, angles away, and angles away too wide. Called. breaks the maiden
goes for the heave-ho, mis-hits it back to Pathan
pitched up wide, Reddy doesn't go after it
swinging in towards off again, defended from the crease
swinging in towards off, defended respectfully
